units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite> (transl. <he>סרו מהר</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:8">Ex. XXXII, 8</cite>) <he>סטו בפ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:7">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אינשמת בפ׳</he> you might have recovered quickly. M’norath Hammaor, ed. Stettin, Nr. 9 quot. fr. Kallah, <he>אמאי לא תיתי בפ׳</he> why dost thou not come quickly?
